effective.basis: TCG release of Gold Series (GLD1-EN028), the printing that carries the reduced DEF

changes.summary: Stat-only erratum: the Gold Series printing dropped DEF from 3800 to 3000 (the lineage's English versions carry nothing but the DEF line - v0 'DEF/3800', v1 'DEF/3000'), and upstream's variant is exactly that card, cards-unofficial.cdb 511006007 at ATK 4500 / DEF 3000 against cards.cdb 23995346 at 4500 / 3800. The Fusion materials line and the card's own behaviour are untouched.

effective.basis: TCG release of Retro Pack (RP01-EN000), which restores DEF 3800

changes.summary: The reduced DEF was reverted: v2 (RP01-EN000) prints 'DEF/3800' again, which is the modern value in cards.cdb. After this transition the modern implementation is correct, so no historical implementation attaches to it.

review.notes: The oldest recorded version (v0, JMP-EN005, DEF 3800) is identical to the modern card, so the baseline needs no substitution; the upstream variant belongs to the intermediate DEF-3000 version and is attached there. Recording both transitions matters: had only the restoration been recorded, every snapshot before it - including GOAT (2005-04-01), which predates the misprint entirely - would have selected the DEF-3000 card. As recorded, GOAT and Edison (2010-04-24) both resolve to the modern 3800 card and only the 2008-04-02 .. 2008-07-08 window selects 511006007. historical_text_version / modern_text_version are null deliberately: this errata page's English versions contain DEF markup only ('<center>DEF/3800</center>'), no card text, and the printed materials line is unchanged. Date anomaly, flagged: the packet's set_dates for Retro Pack list tcg-eu 2008-07-08 alongside tcg-na 2024-08-23 under one product id; the applier will take the earliest (2008-07-08), but the 2024 entry looks like a same-name product conflated into the release data and should be checked. Script difference is an API equivalence - Fusion.AddProcCodeRep(c,CARD_BLUEEYES_W_DRAGON,3,true,true) versus Fusion.AddProcMixN(c,true,true,CARD_BLUEEYES_W_DRAGON,3), both three named copies with substitutes allowed, both with EnableReviveLimit - with one caveat: the historical entry lacks s.material_setcode=SET_BLUE_EYES, metadata other (modern) cards read when checking a Fusion Monster's listed material archetype.
